2023 Governance Index Model

Source: R/data.R
gov_model_2023.Rd

Item parameters of the 2023 anchor model used by get_scores(model = "2023"): a bifactor two-parameter logistic item response model (mirt::bfactor) fit to the 16 GI_* practice items for every 501(c)(3) organization that e-filed a full Form 990 for tax year 2023. Fitting code: data-raw/fit-model-2023.R in the package source.

Usage

gov_model_2023

Format

A list with elements:

values

parameter table from mirt::mod2values(), used to rebuild the model with fixed parameters when scoring

spec

testlet assignment of each item (1 financial assurance, 2 minutes, 3 written policies, 4 compensation, NA general only)

items

item names, in model order

factors

names of the score columns, in factor order

year, n

anchor tax year and number of organizations

logLik, BIC

fit statistics

loadings

standardized loadings on the general and specific factors

item_means

share of 2023 filers reporting each practice

mirt_version, fitted

mirt version used and date fitted
